title: Entity
description: The one object every relationship sends: a person, an organisation or a record. Every relation cell, picker row and reference reads this object and shows as much of it as its variant allows (name, name + key, avatar + name, full, chip, stack, ref, picker). Data display contract, layer 1.

id.description: Stable identity, used for keys, selection and the sidecar.

kind.description: What the thing is. Decides the rule grid row (entity person vs entity record).

description.description: One line under the name: a role, an email, a record's summary.

image.description: Avatar or logo URL. Without one, initials are drawn.

initials.description: Up to two letters. Derived from the label when absent.

tone.description: Avatar tone when there is no image.

key.description: A short human key shown in mono: RLY-497, INV-0042.

sidecar.description: A sidecar address; when present the value opens the record beside the page (the ref variant).

stat.description: One figure beside the entity in the full variant: open deals, last seen.

fallback.description: The avatar cascade: the mark drawn when the entity has no image of its own. A model names its family, and the family names its platform; the first image down the chain is drawn, else the initials.

label.description: Whose mark it is: Claude, Claude Code CLI.
